bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to public safety; appropriating money for a Community Engagement Response Team.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION; COMMUNITY ENGAGEMENT RESPONSE TEAM. +]

[+$250,000 for fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of public safety for a grant to a nonprofit organization to fund a Community Engagement Response Team (CERT) in the Rochester area. The team must be comprised of community leaders and volunteers and focus on improving public safety by acting as a liaison between the Black community and law enforcement, and on curating opportunity, mediating problems, and providing advocacy for the Black, Indigenous, and people of color (BIPOC) community. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to public safety; appropriating money for a Community Engagement Response Team.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; COMMUNITY ENGAGEMENT RESPONSE TEAM.

$250,000 for fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of public safety for a grant to a nonprofit organization to fund a Community Engagement Response Team (CERT) in the Rochester area. The team must be comprised of community leaders and volunteers and focus on improving public safety by acting as a liaison between the Black community and law enforcement, and on curating opportunity, mediating problems, and providing advocacy for the Black, Indigenous, and people of color (BIPOC) community.
additions: $250,000 for fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of public safety for a grant to a nonprofit organization to fund a Community Engagement Response Team (CERT) in the Rochester area. The team must be comprised of community leaders and volunteers and focus on improving public safety by acting as a liaison between the Black community and law enforcement, and on curating opportunity, mediating problems, and providing advocacy for the Black, Indigenous, and people of color (BIPOC) community.
